entries.groups.producer.title: The producer's mapping, not a sealed record
entries.groups.tier.judged.title: Decided by a pinned model applying a frozen rubric
entries.groups.tier.recomputed.title: A fixed check anyone can repeat from the records
entries.groups.ob.ok.unverified: No exceptions found · {unverified} could not be verified
entries.groups.row.nothing: Not checked: no session has a result
entries.groups.row.unverified-note: {n} could not be verified (failed verification or evidence missing)
entries.groups.summary.h: What was checked and what we found
entries.groups.summary.lede: Each session (one conversation with the agent) was checked against {tests} under {obligations}. Results are counts of sessions: there is no overall score. Open a test to read the sessions behind its exceptions.
entries.groups.summary.basis: Every count and result is read from the sealed claims and reports in this bundle, or marked "not stated". The regulation named above, obligation titles, test names, the article, the plain-language summary, applicability, method, finding ids, severities, recommendations and the notes on undecided tests and quality checks are the producer's mapping, set in italics: carried beside the signed records, not in them.
entries.groups.unverified-note: no verdict drawn: neither met nor an exception
entries.groups.pf.case-record.from-claims: {record} (cited by every claim of this session; the reports that name it are withheld)
entries.groups.pf.no-claim: no claim: Result v0 carries none for a test that did not apply
entries.groups.rp.toggle: Proofs for this report: method, test wording, what ran, and how to verify the whole bundle
entries.groups.od.h: Method and the wording each test ran
entries.groups.od.mapped: Title, article, summary, method, test names and the undecided-session note: the producer's mapping, in italics, not a sealed record.
entries.groups.od.unmapped: The producer's extension does not map this obligation: article, summary and method not stated.
entries.groups.od.wording.mixed: Wording not stated: the cited reports state different wordings.
entries.groups.od.wording.unstated: Wording not stated: no cited report states it.
entries.groups.q.none: No quality protocol declared in this pack.
entries.groups.vd.note: This bundle's own checkpoint, an append-only Merkle Mountain Range over the sealed records. Repeat every check on this page offline with the open-source verifier. This report is drawn only when this page's checks let the records be shown: tamper with any sealed claim, record or checkpoint and the report is not drawn. The page then shows the red "✗ This bundle did not verify: do not rely on it" callout, the checks that failed and each record's id and status, with no record content.
entries.judge.note.sure: The judge gave this verdict a probability of {p}%.
entries.case.label: task {task}
entries.chat.absent: The conversation is not in this bundle. It is sealed in the case record {record}, which this report does not disclose, so this page cannot show it.
entries.chat.not-shown.default-reason: the transcript in this bundle does not check against the case the judge read
entries.chat.lede: {messages} messages, {calls}. {state} Tool results are shown as sealed; JSON is only indented, and only where indenting changes nothing else. Tool arguments are shown as the report model hands them over, re-serialised, so a number JSON cannot hold exactly may already be rounded.
entries.chat.state.cited: The conversation of the case every claim cites. The judge's reports are withheld, so which conversation the judge read is not shown.
entries.chat.state.verified: The exact conversation the judge read, checked on this page (see the proofs).
entries.spot.term: The rule, as the judge was given it
entries.spot.term.unstated: The rule's wording is not in this bundle: no report in it states the wording.
entries.spot.term.mixed: The rule's wording is not shown: the reports in this bundle state different wordings.
entries.spot.gap.produced: Who produced each message (model, tools used, effects) is not in this bundle: a message here carries only who spoke, what was said and the tool calls.
entries.spot.gap.when: This report states only each rule's wording, not when it counts as met or when it cannot be decided.
entries.spot.gap.adjudication: This card does not show whether a second, blind judge checked these verdicts.
entries.card.basis.source: source says (backfilled record; the source's own timestamp, self-attested)
entries.card.basis.judged: the day the judgments were sealed (no case record date to read)
entries.card.dating.source: Dates are the source's own timestamps for backfilled records ("source says"), as given, not when the records were sealed.
entries.card.dating.record: The period is when the conversations happened (each case record's own time, as given), not when they were judged.
entries.card.dating.mixed: Dates are each conversation's own date, as given, not when the judgments were sealed:
entries.card.dating.mixed.source: {n} backfilled by the source's own timestamp ("source says");
entries.card.dating.mixed.record: {n} by the case record's own timestamp;
entries.card.dating.mixed.judged: {n} with no case record date to read, by the day they were judged.
entries.card.dating.self-attested: A backfilled record's source time is self-attested: carrying it does not make it witnessed.
entries.card.dating.tz: Timezone not stated on {count} of {total}; no zone is assumed.

entries.card.gap.notes.some-withheld: The judge's notes are not in this bundle: some of its reports are withheld.
